nom: Dermalogica Deep Acne Invisible Liquid Patch

avis.texte: So far, I like it. The first few days it brought up some acne I didn't know was around what I bought this for. Now it has all cleared up. I have not had any bad reaction. So, for me this seems to work. I hope it continues to work long term.

Only 3 days in and I'm already seeing incredible results! I'm truly impressed with how much my skin has improved in such a short time. I'm so glad I decided to switch completely to this brand for my entire facial cleansing routine. My skin already looks clearer, brighter, and healthier.
I get deep cystic acne on my chin randomly and often and this cream is a MIRACLE worker. It fades away within 2 days. Worth. Every. Single. Penny.

I was excited to try because of the other reviews, but it didn't do anything. I tried for about 3 days and it was like it froze my acne in time which was odd. My pimples didn't develop, but they also didn't heal. I think this product is really innovative with the liquid to solid patch, so it would be awesome if it did work. I tried with putting a lot vs a little on, and it didn't make a difference either.

This stuff is a miracle worker. Sometimes i get deep pimples that linger and you can see the raised bump even covering with makeup, this product helps to rid of the bump completely!! I use it every night on a stubborn pimple (make sure you put a decent glob on to cover it) and usually its gone by the weekend! Highly recommend

I don't understand why this is so expensive for what it is. I was expecting some miracle product after splurging on this. I could not tell you what it does. I ended up just utilizing pimple patches again instead because I did not feel like it had any impact. I was very disappointed and will not repurchase. I recommend you save your money!
This is great for break outs. It has helped my blemishes heal faster.

I highly recommend Dermalogica's deep acne liquid patch. This is the best spot treatment I have ever used! I had a large cyst for almost two weeks and nothing worked to clear it. This reduced the size and redness after just one use!
Love this product for breakouts! Does exactly what it claims to. 10/10 would recommend and repurchase

My holy grail product! This is the only product I have tried that has improved my cystic acne! I don't notice any smell during application, and it feels great on because it's light and absorbs a lot of oil without being overly drying. I even noticed that it started to improve and lighten some of my dark spots/acne scarring after only several days of use.
I cannot believe how quickly this works to stop acne in it tracks. I love how easy it is to apply. It has a bit of a sulphury smell but quickly fades once it has been absorbed into the skin.

There is definitely a slight sulfur smell, but if you suffer like I do w peri menopausal hormonal acne, the smell doesnt matter. This product takes the angry out almost immediately, heals very quickly and, most importantly, it keeps me from picking (resulting in scabs)!!! My zits heal in a matter of days and i can refrain from attacking my face, tearing it to shreds. So, yes, it's expensive. Yes, it smells. My peace of mind and clear skin is absolutely worth the it. Ive been using 2+ months.
Easy application and diminished my acne overnight. Formula goes on clear.
Worth every penny. Cleared a deep spot that's been on my chin for a few years, now it's completely flat and barely there, this is after 3 weeks of use. Will definitely be a staple in my skin routine!

I've had hormonal acne for a while and when we started trying for a baby I wanted to make sure all my skin care was pregnant safe. This is the only product I found that literally says preg safe on the packaging! Better yet, it works better than all the spot treatments i was using before! Strongly recommend trying this out! The sulfur smell is mild and goes away once dry. This also works well under make-up.

I've been dealing with some stubborn hormonal breakouts on my jawline for months. My esthetician put this on my last visit and I immediately noticed a difference. I went out and bought my own tube and within days the breakouts were healing and I'm happy to say are now fully gone. Amazing!!!

Ive been struggling with acne for the last year. Ive been having little breakouts here and then but lately i have been full on breaking out all over my chin which has made me super insecure. I have switched up my skincare routine and tried different makeup but literally NOTHING has helped. Ill always wake up with more pimples EVERY SINGLE DAY. But i went into ulta the other day to get a new foundation to try to cover my existing acne and all the scarring ive had. One of the workers there recommended me this product, i was skeptical at first because ive tried a lot of different acne treatments. But when i tell you i used this after i did my nightly skincare routine and went to bed. When i woke up all of the pimples i put the treatment on had either disappeared, flattened significantly, or started to heal immediately. I have been using this product for a solid week and i can say without a doubt this is the only that has helped. I have had barley any pimples pop up since ive started using it and i feel like its helping fade my scarring. The only thing about this im not a fan of is the smell, it definitely has a weird smell but its nothing to bad. Other than that I would recommend this to anyone who is struggling with ance and has sensitive skin. I cant stress how good this stuff is.
This stuff is my holy Grail!!!!! I will never use any other acne treatment ever again because it'll never top this one. Thank you so much, Dermalogica.

I'll admit that I'm kind of sensitive to smells, but the sulphur in the product is very hard to miss. This product is pretty smelly. However, I'm willing to endure just how smelly it is because it works SO WELL for what I use it for. It calms and clears angry acne and ingrown hairs from shaving SO FAST! I tend to be skeptical of pricier products because it's not uncommon for cheaper products to work just as well but I haven't found anything that works as well for me as this does. And it doesn't even bother or trigger my psoriasis, so that's an extra bonus for me!

avis.titre: Spot treatment with actual noticeable results!
avis.texte: As the title says, this spot treatment actually gives noticeable results. I use this as my final step in my nighttime skincare routine when I notice any whiteheads creeping up. By morning, the spots have reduced in size and redness significantly, if not diseappearing completely. I'm 23 with combo skin and this makes a huge difference in how long my breakouts last, going from almost two weeks to clearing up in a few days. Took off one star because the smell is really strong and the product is a little hard to dispense, but love that this product is pregnancy safe!

I am getting deep, sensitive to the touch bumps on my chin but don't feel confortable using salicylic acid every day. I found this and love that they put "pregnancy safe" right in the description! Better yet IT WORKS!! After one night of using, the bumps were no longer sensitive and they were drying up to white heads. After second night they were healed.
I should say face saver. I am having hormone changes again at 42 years old and my cystic acne came back with a vengeance. This was the only thing that made any dent.

I bought this because I have been breaking out sooooo bad lately. I have tried everything and anything. I came across this when I was looking for something to help adult acne/cystic acne. I put it in mom overnight on a pimple that I had recently popped and was red, the next mooring I woke up it was completely gone. Also on some of my scarring and redness that I had from another breakout as well. It visibly reduced the redness in my acne overnight . I can't wait to see how it does when using it on a reg basis. I'm trying to clear my skin up before my vacation, and I think this might be the miracle that I have been looking for. Really should give it a try if you are looking for something that works l!!

i get angry cystic acne about once a month and hadn't ever been able to really do anything about it, but this stuff really speeds the healing process. i'm gonna keep this in my cabinets forever. it does have a not-great smell, which i thought was really strong the first couple times i used it and then basically stopped noticing it. honestly, even if i did think it smelled every time i'd still be using it because it just really works.

I've been a fan of the Dermalogica line for a long time so I figured I'd try their acne spot patch for my occasional hormonal acne. It's literally the only spot treatment I've ever used that will make a pimple go away and go flat overnight. I still can't believe how well it works time after time. It dries nice and fast, and stays on the skin well so I don't have to worry about it rubbing off on my pillow.

I've been treating my acne since about age 11, and now I am almost 40. This spot treatment is the most effective spot treatment I've tried; and I've havd many dermatologists prescribed products over the years. Its shrinks any pimple and speeds up the healing process. I have cystic acne and 'basic' white head type acne and it helps both. I dont know if I've ever had a topical work this well on deep pimples. Try it! A little goes a long way, so it lasts a long time. Smells a little like sulfur while its dries, but it works so well I dont mind.
Didnt help with a single pimple. Also pricey. Possibly first product from Dermalogica that i didnt like

I use this as soon as I feel a cystic pimple forming. It's invisible, so it wears well with or without makeup. On my skin, it legitimately has the same effect as a cortisone injection. And much like cortisone, if you wait too long, it's less effective. But when used as directed, this product has saved me so many trips to the dermatologist that I've lost count. Highly recommend.
Everyone's skin is different, and unfortunately, this didnt work for mine. I applied at night and woke up with blister-like bumps on my face.

I use this sparingly, but when I do, it definitely helps. nice to be able to kill a deep painful pimple during the day without bringing attention to my face with some bright dried cakey product. it's a little pricey, but totally worth it. a little goes a long way.

I have suffered from acne almost my entire life and I have tried just about every product on the market. This is HANDS DOWN the BEST! It works and it works fast. A little goes a long way so only use as a spot treatment. Unbelievably effective!!

I've been dealing with deep painful cystic acne that never comes to a head,one pimple will last for WEEKS,some were painful even if I just moved my face/neck a certain way,always painful to the touch,and if I tried to pop it...some oil/liquid would come out.I've tried everything to help these breakouts, EVERYTHING. salicylic acid,benzoyl peroxide,face steaming,ice cube,warm compress,all kinda of lotions,serums and potions. I saw this stuff while scrolling thru the app one day and was like ehh f it,let's give it a shot I have nothing to lose at this point.when I tell you OVERNIGHT my acne spots(cystic&other types) cleared up. literally went from O to . shrunk over half its size..overnight! it takes the redness down,takes the excruciating pain away,id say within 2-4 days the blemish is gone.(some are more stubborn than others)THIS STUFF IS THE REAL DEAL! the price tag is 100000% worth it! at first I thought the bottle looked small but you don't need a lot on the spot, so it will last.& its cool cause it does dry down and create a little patch type thing over the blemish. I'm not a fan of fragrance in skin products,but the smell doesn't last long at all so I don't mind it,plus it really works so it's worth it. I can't reccomend this stuff enough! also I'd like to note that this is NOT sponsored, I paid for the product with my own money,nobody is paying or encouraging me to say good things about this stuff. I saw a lot of reviews that said ppl were sent the product in exchange fo

I got a sample from Ulta. I used a sample of something else that gave me cystic pimples and this product brought them to surface in 24 hours and got rid of them faster than I've ever gotten rid of a cystic pimple. Im adding this to my must have products list. Magic!!

This product is really good for when you feel or see a pimple coming on, or if you already have one and want it to go away. It also reduces the inflammation. The only con is that it smells after you wash it off the next morning (like the sulfur in it), BUT to be fair, i only wash my face off with water in the mornings. It might not smell if you wash your face with cleanser or any other wash. Either way, it is a small price to pay for a good spot treatment.

Ive been struggling with acne all of a sudden lately. Like way worse than usual. I had tried the pimple patches and some work well but i was blowing through the boxes. I ordered a face wash from this company and came across this. So glad i purchased. It has been super helpful at drying up and clearing my acne. I use it everynight before bed while i get these breakouts under control

I've always struggled with adult acne, with it finally calming down in my 30s. I still get the occasional breakout or cystic acne spot, and this has cleared these up IMMEDIATELY. Literally overnight. The sulfur in it isnt the best smell to go to sleep with, but when I used it in the morning I couldn't smell it. If you struggle with acne, spend the money on this instead of continuing to try cheaper alternatives (guilty!)

Bought this on a whim one winter night. I'm 33 and have had adult acne for about 2 years and nothing NOTHING has helped like this product. I love that it can be applied morning and night and is seamless under sunscreen, makeup, etc. Not sure how it works layering under other serums etc bc I've been truing to heal my skin so i stopped my oral spirnolactone, prescription retinols, vit c, etc to give this a fair shot. I will be buying this for the rest if time!!!
If you suffer with painful pimples this spot treatment will decrease the discomfort associated with breakouts. Huge bonus for removing redness from around my acne, sometimes overnight!
works well for my teens with most inflammations. Tapered tip helps control dispensing, so it lasts.
Life saver for cystic acne. Both myself at 52 and my son at 17 are very happy with it.

HO-LY-GRAIL! This product is AMAZING! It gets my hormonal, cystic acne under control. When I'm on trail, I only take this tiny tube, apply AM & PM all over my chin and I get NO ACNE. I cannot recommend this enough.
I use a thin layer and it is more than enough. Less is more in the amount.
Shipping was great it came in a good condition. It does the job! I'm happy with it.
My skin broke out in a horrible rash after using this product.

Im 38, i struggled with acne as a teen but have had clear alin until a few months ago. Nothimg seemed to work. Yesterday I bought this, used it before bed and -HOLY COW- this morning my semi-large and red pimples are nearly gone! This is a real review. Not paid for, no incentives. Just a real woman struggling with acne again. BUY THIS!!! I wish i had sooner!

this magical potion clears up deep spots quickly or than anything I've tried, except one other sulfur based treatment. But this smells great, I love the consistency of the product and I'm really relieved to have a solution for my acne

i wanted so badly for this NOT to work because of how pricey it is, but it works too good. it gets rid of my pimples so quickly & calms them down. not only that, but i actually put it on top of an area that i thought was acne scars, turns out they were still small pimples that my skin had just healed over?! this got rid of them so quickly i'm so upset im gonna have to buy this again. my only petty complaint is that is does have the tinest medication-like smell, can be a bit annoying if i apply to areas that are near my nose like my chin for example.
Hasn't really helped prevent any new blemishes from coming but I'm going to keep using and hope for the best.
Great for deep blemishes that are just forming under the skin. Prevented a major blemish from developing, and didn't irritate my skin. A little goes a long way.
Works great! Noticed blemishes decrease overnight with use of product. I have very sensitive skin
This is a game changer for those deep under the skin pimples! When I put this on one they usually disappear within a couple of days and don't even ever come to the surface, amazing! Love it 10/10

My teenage son's sensitive skin was breaking out and nothing was working. This is a miracle treatment! The formula is not too harsh for sensitive and his skin looked better in a matter of a few days! I will be ordering more!
This is FABULOUS!takes redness out immediately, even worked for my husband.

I have been struggling with breaking out since I got off my birth control, and as soon as it came in, I put it on and my spots significantly decreased or went away entirely after using. So so so happy with this product!!!

avis.titre: Amazing for getting rid of acne problems
avis.texte: Helps shield your skin barrier from pimples showing. Texture is smooth and goes on gently..

This is probably one of the most effective spot treatments i've ever used. Im not too fond of the smell but it doesn't bother me enough to not use. I will put this on at night and my blemish is half the size just overnight. You can also wear it under makeup and you dont notice. I recommend this product to all of my friends and with the minimal product needed this will last you a very long time!!

My aesthetician gave me a sample of this, knowing that I still, in my 70s, get serious blemishes. I was amazed at how it stopped those developing blemishes in their tracks. Gone. Like magic. So, I immediately bought this. Easy to apply. Just a little bit is needed to work the magic.

avis.titre: Takes Away Pimples Without Drying the Skin!
avis.texte: I LOVE this spot treatment. It takes away breakouts FAST without leaving the skin red, irritated and dry after. It helps so much especially with the deep, painful breakouts. Best spot treatment on the market!
I have tried at least 11 spot treatments and this is far out the BEST! Costly but worth it.

I have very sensitive and acne prone skin and i have tried so many spot treatments and have gone through numerous pimple patches. This stuff makes sure deep underground pimples never reach the surface. I would say depending on the size of the pimple this product eliminates it in just a few days. Awsome product!

avis.titre: Great for overnight treatment and looks invisible during the
avis.texte: I really like this for spot treating acne especially the ones that are about to be inflamed, painful and deep beneath the surface. Sulfur containing products work really well for treating deep acnes on my skin and are less irritating than benzoyl peroxide products. I also love how it dries completely on the skin which is perfect for overnight treatment (less prone to be rubbed off onto pillows) as well as during the day (it looks more invisible than acne patches if you apply a very thin layer). You can see from the red marks on my skin they have completely flatten down and are no longer painful to the touch after a few days of use. (Gifted by Dermalogica for my honest opinions).

This really helped make my pimples not be so red and inflamed! Helped them heal quickly. Another great product from Dermalogica! I would recommend this to a friend!!! Thank you, Gifted by Dermalogica.

I truly believe that spot treatments with sulphur are the best for acne! When using this one I get like my breakouts were smaller and less red/irritated overnight. With continued use I felt like it helped breakouts more quickly. My only issue is with describing the spot treatment as a liquid patch and completely clear. I didn't find that it dried down and created a patch. Also, maybe I was using too much, but it wasn't clear for me! Oh well, I love the results. Gifted by Dermalogica.

This deep acne invisible liquid patch spot treatment was gifted by Dermalogica and is hands down the best spot treatment I have tried to this day. I tend to get painful acne during a certain time of the month and this product helped relieve the pain and inflammation from my acne within a day. Within 2 days I noticed that the acne had become almost nonexistent. Overall, I am a big fan of this new liquid patch as it actually works!

Dermalogica gifted me. Acne liquid patch from dermalogica does a good job. It dried my acne in two days, but did not remove the redness, it leaves a white coating after application. Works well with subcutaneous acne.

I love this product, it's super effective! Whenever I breakout I get those deep underneath pimples, which are super painful and difficult to get rid of quickly. After using this product I noticed my breakouts resolve quicker and don't get as big compared to how they normally do. Plus, this product doesn't dry out my skin. Gifted by Dermalogica

This is a really unique product! It does dry down and create a nice barrier between any active or upcoming acne. I prefer to use this at night. It doesn't take too long to dry down and really does help reduce active and upcoming acne. This can be a little drying if used more than 3 nights in a row but on the initial use doesn't leave any dry skin. I've seen visible reductions in acne and having this layer helps me leave my acne alone and not pick at it. I received this complimentary from Dermalogica but all thoughts are my own.

I received this complimentary from Dermalogica for review. I have combination skin and is mostly blemish free, but I do have occasional spots. After using the spot treatment and leaving it on overnight the next day any redness and acne is mostly gone. I apply a light thin layer and it works quickly, and it doesn't irritate or dry my skin.

I was excited to try this because I had a pimple pop up right before receiving it. After two rounds, it flattened it completely. It dries up your zit, best to do overnight because it will be completely white.

Simple and effective. This is a gentle, clear, calm spot treatment that actually helps! I prefer to use it overnight. Kindly gifted by Dermalogica and honestly used and reviewed by me. Definitely worth checking out!

I really like this acne patch and how it's applied. It's not like others that stay on and you peel off later but you can tell someone is wearing it. I really enjoy the application and would absolutely recommend! Gifted by Dermologica

This product definitely helped to dry out my breakout and allow it to clear faster. My skin is sensitive, and this product did not cause any irritation or burning, however it is very drying ! So make sure to use a good moisturizer and don't reapply too often. It helped clear a large, painful breakout on my chin within a few days. I love this brand! Gifted by dermalogica but opinions are my own

avis.titre: Works well as a spot treatment
avis.texte: I have been enjoying this product so far, but I don't know if I would describe it as an acne, patch or rather a spot treatment. The reason why I opt for acne patches is because it absorbs all of the oil and impurities from my acne spots. This product, however, does cover acne like a patch, but, I do not see oils or impurities drawn out overtime. I do notice that it works well as a spot treatment for my acne, but I don't think that it works the same as an acne patch. Gifted by Dermalogica.

Really easy to use and effective. It doesn't irritate my skin and no one knows it's even on! Plus it works and I can definitely see this replacing my patches and being a go . Gifted by Dermalogica but it's a keeper

This is such a nice innovative product that actually works. I use it the moment I see or feel a blemish forming in my skin. It smooths irritate skin, and helps prevent future breakouts. I recommend it. Complimentary from Dermalogica

This worked so much better than I thought it would! I had a painful pimple in my brow and this took that pain away and the blemish was gone within a day or two. I've used it on under the surface pimples and it cured those without bringing them to the surface. 10/10. Gifted by Dermalogica

This really worked to help reduce inflammation on the pimple! I didn't experience any irritation and I felt like it shortened the duration of the red, inflammatory stage by a day or two. Overall it was very effective and I'll reach for it again! Gifted by Dermalogica

I really love this deep acne liquid patch and how it acts as an acne patch. I can apply and go about my day. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly. Has a slight scent. I have oily dry skin and this has really helped improve my skin quickly when I see any blemishes appear. This just might be replaces my patches. I was gifted by Dermalogica.

A little bit goes along way. My second time using acne patches and it works really well. I'm actually really surprised. It doesn't dry out my skin. This was gifted by Dermalogica. I've struggled with acne for a while and I appreciate this solution to my problem!

This spot treatment is seriously next level! I had to reread the packaging because it legit worked so well I didn't understand lol! Dermalogica has not done me wrong yet! Love the cooling effect and that it really sinks in deep (and clear) 10/10 for me! Gifted by brand

As someone who's struggled with acne my entire life, I'm so happy to find this product. As soon as you speculate a breakout to happen, apply this acne treatment and somehow those pimples never form! It's an amazing pre-breakout treatment. Highly recommend! Gifted by Dermalogica but always an honest reviewer.

This was actually incredible! I wasn't expecting much but it actually cleared up acne pretty much overnight!!! I thought it was going to be pretty thick and noticeable after drying but it wasn't! It helped more than any other spot treatment I've used! This was gifted by Dermalogica.

avis.titre: A must have do acne treatment
avis.texte: This product has magic in it, it really does the trick, it's has been my go to for those stubborn blemishes that don't go away. It's not drying my skin at all. I use this as a spot treatment. I have tried many things for pimples and this is one of my favorites. Highly recommended.

This was gifted by Dermalogica to me in return for my honest opinion. It came at a fabulous time, because a breakout had just started. So these weren't like under the skin, but they were already red and angry looking. After the first application (right before bed the night it came in), I noticed a difference in the morning; they were less red looking, less inflamed. I continued using it a couple of times per day (just during morning and nighttime skincare), and they went away faster than they normally would. It goes on super thin, and then it dries pretty fast. Once it dries, it feels (and looks) like there's nothing on your face. You can put makeup over it, wear it to bed without it getting on your pillow; it's a great product!

As someone who suffers from acne all the time, and a diehard fan of Dermalogica, I was super excited for this product! Although dermalogica has really cleared up my acne since using it, you still get the occasional stubborn pimple. After using this, Dermalogica patch, it really made such a huge difference and cleared up that pimple in one day. This was gifted by dermalogica!

Dermalogica gifted me their Deep Acne Invisible Liquid Patch and I found it to be an effective spot treatment for acne and blemishes. It's great that it can be applied at the first sign of a breakout to help prevent it from fully developing. The fact that it transforms from a liquid to a patch is interesting and unique. I appreciate that it forms a semi-permeable patch that allows airflow while protecting the skin from pollution and irritants. The inclusion of Colloidal Sulfur at 5% concentration helps to combat breakouts and clear the skin quickly. The addition of Niacinamide at 4% concentration is a nice touch, as it helps to soothe the skin and fade post-breakout marks. The application process seems straightforward, and the product dries down quickly. I like that it can be reapplied throughout the day as needed, although it's important to avoid using it near the eyes and lips. Overall, if you struggle with acne and blemishes, this product seems worth trying. It combines the benefits of sulfur and niacinamide to soothe and clear the skin.

Dermalogica as a brand for me speaks to simple and effective. The products in my experience do just what they said they would and while I received this one complimentary from Dermalogica my experience is no different. I had two small pimples, I put a little acne patch on, allowed it to dry, felt the tingle from the camphor, pimples were gone in two days. What can I say? It worked!

I like this unique acne product. It has a funky smell that I actually like, almost like eucalyptus (it's the camphor that smells). I like how it seems to work but also be gentler on your skin, no more peeling flaky irritated skin from too much salicylic acid! I'll definitely keep using this on my occasional hormonal breakouts. This was gifted by dermalogica for review.

This has me absolutely shocked. When they say deep acne patch they mean deep acne patch. You can feel it dry down some but it's not an overly tight or wrinkled feeling like other products that dry down to create a layer. You don't really feel it or see it once it's applied. It's like it's not there. Super cool!

This makes any of my pimples or breakouts disappear. It's pricey but you only need a little bit and it'll last a long time! It's super effective compared to pimple patches or my other spot treatments. Gifted by dermalogica

Gifted by dermalogica! This has been a game changer for my skin when I am experiencing cystic acne! I typically have bad reactions to spot treatments, but this has not been the case with this one! An absolute game changer

Gifted by dermalogica Wow this cleared up a deep pimple within two days. Brought it to a head and helped it heal without scaring or redness. So happy to have this for breakout emergencies in the future. Awesome product and would recommend

Gifted by dermalogica. I have found this acne spot treatment to be a dream! I get a couple breakouts right before my period and once I feel that bump i've been applying a dot of this nightly and usually within a day or two it goes back down.

I tried the Dermalogica Deep Acne Liquid Patch on some acne on my chin. It is very soothing and did not irritate my sensitive skin. If you have acne, you must give this a try. I am going to use this instead of all the pimple patches I have. Gifted by Dermalogica.

Gifted by Dermalogica. This was my first time trying any acne products from this brand & I love this product so much now. It made a difference after leaving it on for the time it said. I definitely recommend this product for those with acne or blemishes.
